description: Zachary's karate club with Zachary's interaction counts (1-7) as ratings on a 0-7 scale, both directions

sources.networkx: strength, degree, betweenness, harmonic closeness, eigenvector, constraint, effective size, clustering, density, overall reciprocity, average clustering, components, Louvain and modularity
sources.python: symmetrisation, rescaling, composite, dyad reciprocity, centralisation, E-I index, cross-group density, signed in-valence and triads, multiplexity, resilience reachability and averages (from networkx shortest paths), cut-off counts (from networkx components) and load concentration (from networkx in-degree); edge betweenness uses nx.edge_betweenness_centrality, local bridges nx.local_bridges(with_span=True) and cut points nx.articulation_points; shortest paths use nx.all_shortest_paths and nx.dijkstra_path_length
